To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel deep learning model of transfer neural tree for heterogeneous domain adaptation and zero shot learning.

we propose a deep learning model, TNT, which is able to handle semi supervised heterogeneous domain adaptation and zero shot learning in a unified architecture, and we demonstrate that TNT outperforms state of the art approaches.

we proposed a novel deep neural network model for HDA which is able to jointly learn cross domain feature mapping and adaptation, and also can be extended to semi supervised HDA and zero shot learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following three aspects.
the problem of transfer learning across heterogeneous domains.
the following three aspects: 1) HDA, 2) zero shot learning, and 3) deep neural tree.

our TNT is able to achieve the best performance on all tasks and datasets in the paper.

our TNT is able to learn a unified deep model to solve the HDA task with semi supervised data and even zero shot learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a unified architecture to handle different types of domain adaptation tasks.
we have successfully developed a unified framework of TNT for HDA and beyond.
we provide a novel framework for heterogeneous domain adaptation, which can be further extended to other related learning tasks.

deep learning models can benefit from the tree-based ensemble methods and vice versa.
deep learning can be applied to solve HDA problems and the proposed TNT can be extended for semi-supervised and zero shot learning.
